items.title: Reliable, optional account recovery
items.description: Improved account connectivity on restricted or unstable networks. Recovery through configured subscriptions is optional, and saved account settings are preserved.

items.title: Split Tunneling made simpler
items.description: Turn Split Tunneling on or off without losing your chosen apps. When disabled, the normal device-wide VPN routing settings apply.

items.title: More reliable desktop connections
items.description: Improved desktop sign-in, server checks and handling of slow or interrupted account-service connections.

items.title: Improved Linux AppImage compatibility
items.description: Refreshed the Linux AppImage for broader desktop compatibility and support for AppImageUpdate.

items.title: Clearer Linux downloads
items.description: Updated architecture-specific AppImage, DEB and RPM packages, with consistent download names.

items.title: Consistent v2.0.5 updates
items.description: Updated installer packages, release integrity checks and documentation while preserving existing account, subscription and VPN features.
